attack_next.instructions: Will the next comment in this conversation contain a personal attack, meaning an insult, name-calling, or hostility aimed at a person rather than at their argument?

criteria.true: The next reply is likely to attack or insult one of the participants
criteria.false: The next reply is likely to stay civil, even if people disagree

derail.instructions: Is this conversation heading toward a hostile breakdown between the participants?

tension.instructions: How tense or hostile has this conversation become so far?
criteria: Heated, with pointed, condescending or accusatory remarks
